summary: Iteration 4 — Stock In Receipt Note refinements (DD-MM-YYYY dates, ITEMS right-align, TOTAL QUANTITY column, Edit+Delete buttons, max-serial+1 algorithm, PUT/DELETE endpoints). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: full e2e flow PASS — list dates DD-MM-YYYY, headers right-aligned, edit prefill + Update label + multi-make dropdown, save round-trip, create-then-delete preview rollback (RN/26-27/005 created then deleted, preview returned from 006 to 005), toast 'RN/26-27/005 deleted'. 0 console/page errors.

tested_scenarios.detail: GET /api/receipt-notes/next-no returns max(serial in current FY) + 1 — confirmed max=4 in DB + next_serial=5
POST -> serial N, next_serial=N+1; DELETE -> next_serial drops back to N (max+1 algorithm, no counter)
PUT updates invoice_no, invoice_date, items; rn_no/rn_date/serial/fy preserved. _id excluded.
ITEMS th has class 'text-right'; cell has 'text-right font-mono text-slate-600'
TOTAL QUANTITY column after ITEMS, right-aligned, values 30/10 (sum of items.quantity)
rn-edit-{rn_no} + rn-delete-{rn_no} present under ACTIONS column for every row
Detail dialog shows rn_date=25-04-2026 and invoice_date=20-04-2026 in DD-MM-YYYY
Edit opens form with rn_no=RN/26-27/004 (disabled), rn_date=2026-04-25 (disabled), inv_no=ABC/26-27/1234, inv_date=2026-04-20; Save button label='Update Receipt Note'
In edit mode for part_no=3922900 row, Make dropdown shows ['CSP','TATA','+ Create New Master'] — all current makes from stock_master, not just saved make
Updated invoice_no -> Click Update -> back to list -> new invoice_no visible in row
End-to-end UI verification: preview RN/26-27/005 -> create -> next preview RN/26-27/006 -> delete 005 -> preview drops to RN/26-27/005 again
window.confirm -> DELETE -> toast 'RN/26-27/005 deleted' -> row disappears from list

critical_code_review_comments: Receipt Note next-no algorithm correctly switched from counter to max(serial)+1 within current FY. Race condition is mitigated by unique (fy, serial) compound index + DuplicateKeyError retry on POST — good.
PUT /api/receipt-notes/{id} correctly preserves immutable fields (rn_no, rn_date, serial, fy). Validation reuses the same item validator as POST — no duplication.
fmtDate helper at top of StockInPage.jsx is purely string-based (regex on YYYY-MM-DD prefix); avoids Date timezone bugs. Used consistently in list AND detail dialog.

ReceiptNoteCreate handles edit-mode initialization correctly: hydrates items + re-fetches makes per-row from /stock-master/lookup/makes so dropdown shows all current options including '+ Create New Master'.

StockInPage.jsx is now ~640 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but trending up; consider splitting components (ReceiptNoteList, ReceiptNoteCreate, MakeDropdown, CreateMasterDialog) into separate files when next change adds >50 lines.
DELETE handler uses window.confirm; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app, but acceptable for now.
